title: Residual-VQ Mirror code composition
hypothesis: For logical functions decomposable into staged low-dimensional residual views, a single shared physical basis plus stage-specific Mirror phase indices will reproduce the native residual-VQ rate-distortion frontier with fewer actual bytes than independent vector codebooks; generic coefficient tables test whether savings are just deterministic codebook generation.
physical_object: one shared 16D two-vector basis used by all residual stages
mirror_coordinate: per-target discrete phase index at each residual stage plus stage plane/scale metadata
logical_multiplicity: 128 target functions represented as sums of 1, 2 or 4 quantized residual views
controls: native learned residual VQ with independently stored full-vector codebooks
generic shared-plane residual VQ with explicit Cartesian coefficient codebooks
Mirror residual VQ with one shared basis and deterministic uniform phase grids

task.teacher: four orthogonal 2D residual planes with amplitudes [1,.5,.25,.125] and independent uniform phases
metrics: actual serialized total bytes and bytes/function
number of used codes per stage

development.native_training: fit native full-vector RVQ codebooks on development functions only; fixed Lloyd updates/initialization
development.allowed: predeclared stage and K sweep; no fresh-dependent codebook training

paid_objects: native full-vector residual codebooks or shared basis/plane metadata and stage scales

success_gate: For every fresh world at a matched rate point, Mirror normalized error <=1.05x native RVQ and payload <=80% native RVQ; each used stage must lower held-out error under ablation. Compare generic coefficient-table frontier for Mirror-specific value.
failure_gate: Mirror misses matched rate-distortion/byte gates, stages fail to add useful held-out functions, or generic coefficient control matches the Mirror frontier at equal/fewer bytes.
boundaries: Synthetic product-of-circles residual functions with known orthogonal planes, not natural model edits or learned task functions.
Native RVQ codebooks train on development data only; fresh targets only assign codes and measure.
Logical code combinations are not counted as capacity; only measured quality, bytes, code usage and stage ablations matter.
